text: {"judgments":[{"claim_index":0,"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED","reason":"Framing claim asserts a fact ('No. Only the Budget & Timeline Breakdown calls it the highest-risk item') and has no evidence; it also makes an exclusivity assertion about the documents."},{"claim_index":1,"verdict":"SUPPORTED","reason":"The quote from the Budget & Timeline Breakdown's Risk Notes states exactly that the Engineering team flagged smart TV integration testing as the highest-risk item on the timeline."},{"claim_index":2,"verdict":"PARTIAL","reason":"The Team & Governance Document says smart TV integration testing was 'a high-risk item', which matches. But the claim that it describes it 'only' as high-risk, 'not as the highest-risk one', is an exclusivity statement about the whole document that the cited passage alone doesn't establish."},{"claim_index":3,"verdict":"UNSUPPORTED","reason":"An absence claim is supported only if it says nothing beyond what the documents don't state; this one makes a claim about a specific document's provided passages, which is not a plain statement that the documents do not state something and no evidence confirms it."}]}
